first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A rider straddling Vehicle A and leaning the upper body forward, with a reddish-brown head, a light gray-white area on the shoulders and back, and teal clothing visible on the torso and along the sides of the body.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The motorcycle-like narrow-bodied vehicle ridden by Person A, with exposed beige and gray-green block-like body panels and a long dust-and-smoke trail connected behind its tail.

entities.name: dust-and-smoke trail
entities.identification: The long trail extending from behind the tail of Vehicle A toward the lower-left of the image, containing a gray band-like area, light-beige dust clouds, and gray-brown dark surfaces.

entities.name: orange sandy ground
entities.identification: The warm orange-yellow ground occupying the foreground and middle ground, with dark specks, short streaks, and small stones scattered across its surface.

entities.name: reddish-brown canyon wall
entities.identification: The reddish-brown rock wall spanning the upper background, with a dark olive-brown band along its lower edge and a pointed, downward-hanging pink-orange edge visible in the upper-left area.

entities.name: group of red-orange layered rock towers
entities.identification: The red-orange vertical rock formations gradually revealed from the image-left side, with multiple light-colored wavy strata running across their surfaces.

entities.name: pink plate-like component
entities.identification: The bright-pink vertical plate-like component near the rock towers, with a dark edge line and a short plate protruding beside its base.

entities.name: scattered rocks
entities.identification: Reddish-brown and brown block-like stones and flat rock fragments on the orange sandy ground.

entities.name: distant reddish-brown small object
entities.identification: The low reddish-brown small object near the foot of the reddish-brown canyon wall, compact and irregular in shape, with short protrusions along its edge.
